title: An approval sent with a request body that then hangs up logs no warning naming the user
notes: The handler never reads the body, so the hang-up goes unnoticed and only 'request failed' is logged (D-097's re-review, by command). Awaits the product owner's triage in the next batch. D-101: dropped; the failure is already logged as 'request failed' and an operator loses nothing they can act on.
